resources.string: This service helps you focus by monitoring the apps you use.
This uses your emergency stop to end the session immediately. You won\'t get another for several weeks. Are you sure?
Choose an enchantment below to begin
Tap to manage on the Focus tab
Still sealed — the seal lifts in %1$d min
Seal your most distracting app behind a conscious, timed pact — and watch the reflex count drop.
Prefer timed focus sessions? Cast one from the Focus tab.
Sealed by default — opening asks how long you truly need
Open by default — a daily time limit, with an optional per-session cooldown
Each repeat on the same day lasts longer
It opens freely again right away.
Every app in this enchantment opens freely again. The enchantment itself is kept.
Your always-on protection — pacts and time limits — now greets you first. Casting focus sessions lives on the Focus tab, one tap away. Everything else works exactly as before.
No enchantments yet. Create one to define which apps to block.
No quick spells yet. Create presets for one-tap focus sessions.
No rituals yet. Schedule automatic focus sessions.
No talismans bound. Scan an NFC tag to get started.
Banish distracting apps or shield only the ones you need. Each enchantment defines which apps are blocked during focus.
No enchantments yet. Tap the + button to create your first one!
Automatically add newly installed apps to this enchantment
This enchantment carries a pact circle — every app in it is sealed by default. Deleting the enchantment removes the circle too.
Cannot change while a spell is active
One emergency stop per cooldown period when you need to end a session early
Automatically start a break after each stretch of focus

Suspend blocked apps at the system level during focus sessions — their icons grey out in the launcher and they can\'t be opened at all
Keep pact-bound apps suspended at all times — greyed out, absent from launcher suggestions, and openable only by requesting time on the Pacts tab
FocusPocus is this device\'s owner. It cannot be uninstalled while Warden Mode is active.
Make FocusPocus the device owner to grey out blocked apps system-wide and prevent the app from being uninstalled in a moment of weakness. One-time setup from a computer with adb:
Temporarily remove all accounts from this phone (Settings → Passwords & accounts). You can add every one of them back as soon as setup is done.
Enable USB debugging (Settings → Developer options) and connect the phone to a computer with adb.
Run this command on the computer:
I ran the command — check status
Warden Mode isn\'t active yet. If the command printed an error, the troubleshooting tips below cover the most common one.
Getting \"there are already some accounts on the device\"?
Some apps (Instagram, WhatsApp, Signal…) register hidden accounts that never show up in Android\'s account settings. List every account on the device with:

In the output, each account\'s \"type\" names the app that owns it. Uninstall that app (or clear its storage), reboot, and run the setup command again. Extra users and work profiles count too — remove them as well. Once Warden Mode is active, reinstall and sign back in to everything.

This build was deployed from Android Studio and is marked test-only \u2014 Android allows removing test-only device owners, so uninstall protection is NOT active. Install with adb (gradlew assembleDebug) for full protection.
A 24-hour cooling-off period starts now. Once it passes, you can remove Warden Mode from here — or cancel the request at any time if the urge passes first.
Ends uninstall protection and app greying. Removal must be requested 24 hours in advance and isn\'t available during a focus session.
FocusPocus will stop greying out blocked apps and can then be uninstalled like any other app. Getting protection back requires running the adb command again.
Could not remove device owner protection
Greys out blocked apps during focus sessions and protects FocusPocus from being uninstalled.
Disabling this lets blocked apps run freely during focus sessions and makes FocusPocus easy to uninstall. Your future self might not thank you.
This app is bound by a Focus Pocus pact.
This app is bound by a Focus Pocus pact, so it stays sealed until you consciously request time. Open Focus Pocus, find the app on the Pacts tab, and tap Request time.
Send anonymous crash reports and usage data to help improve the app
Reflex = abandoned within 30 seconds of opening
To view your app usage statistics, please grant usage access permission.
No usage data available for this period.
Your most distracting apps, sealed until you consciously choose to open them. Let\'s set up your first pacts — timed focus spells are one tap away whenever you want them.
Focus Pocus needs Accessibility permission to notice when you open a sealed or blocked app and offer you a conscious choice instead.
Pick the apps that eat your attention. They\'ll be sealed by default — opening one asks how much time you truly need.
Each pact starts with sensible defaults: up to 15 minutes at a time, then sealed for 30. Tune every pact later on the Pacts tab.
Grant notification access to block notifications from distracting apps and enable Do Not Disturb during focus.
Grant usage access to power daily backstops on your pacts, per-app time limits, and the Insights screen.
The apps you chose now wait behind a conscious pact. Cast timed focus spells from the Focus tab, and shape rituals, talismans, and enchantments in the Spellbook.
We use anonymous crash reports and usage statistics to fix bugs and improve the app. No personal data is collected. You can change this anytime in Settings.

Every focus session earns mana — energy you can spend on boons: rewards you define for yourself. Daily trials and permanent sigils mark your progress along the way.\n\nEverything stays on your device. You can turn it all off in Settings.
